# 【MECCHA CHAMELEON】 FIND ME ZECRETARY !!!!!!

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- Vestia Zeta played a chaotic hide-and-seek/prop hunt style game with viewers, often struggling with controls and game mechanics.
- She experienced numerous humorous moments, including accidental movements, getting stuck, and comically failing to find other players.
- The stream featured self-deprecating humor regarding her hunting and hiding skills, as well as frustration with in-game drawing tools.
- Vestia Zeta frequently expressed panic and emotional reactions to close calls and discoveries, maintaining a lively and engaging atmosphere.
- The stream concluded with Vestia Zeta ending the game early to prevent motion sickness before an upcoming collaboration.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:04:47](#t=00:04:47) Accidental Movement and Panic While Hiding**: After attempting to hide, Vestia Zeta accidentally moves, exclaiming 'I accidentally moved! Why is SOMEONE WHISTLING? I ACCIDENTALLY MOVED. NO. NO, I accidentally moved. I didn't know you can move.'
- **[⏱️ 00:18:24](#t=00:18:24) Stuck in Crawl Position, Vows Never to Crawl Again**: Vestia Zeta gets stuck in a crawling position, receiving a 'not enough space' error when trying to stand, leading her to humorously declare, 'I'm never going to crawl on the floor again.'
- **[⏱️ 00:19:15](#t=00:19:15) Threatening to 'Mass Shoot Everything' Out of Frustration**: During a moment of gameplay frustration, Vestia Zeta comically asks, 'What if I start mass shooting everything?'
- **[⏱️ 00:51:00](#t=00:51:00) Profound Frustration at Inability to Find Players**: Vestia Zeta expresses deep frustration at her inability to find anyone in the game, questioning, 'How the hell? Am I not seeing any? Huh? I'm literally seeing nothing.'
- **[⏱️ 01:00:54](#t=01:00:54) Self-Deprecating Humor as a Hunter**: Vestia Zeta exclaims in frustration, 'Oh my god, I suck as a hunter,' reflecting on her performance in the game.
- **[⏱️ 01:21:04](#t=01:21:04) Humorous Realization of Forgetting to Paint Head**: While camouflaging her character, Vestia Zeta has a self-deprecating realization: 'Oh my god, I forgot to paint this part. It's okay. Oh my god, they forgot. They forgot. I forgot to paint the the the head.'
- **[⏱️ 01:22:30](#t=01:22:30) Triumphant 'Untouchable Hider' Moment**: After being spotted but realizing the hunters cannot harm her, Vestia Zeta triumphantly and repeatedly declares, 'Oh, YOU'RE you can't shoot me. You can't shoot me!'
- **[⏱️ 01:39:15](#t=01:39:15) Ending Stream Early for Collab and to Prevent Motion Sickness**: Vestia Zeta decides to end the game, stating, 'Guys, this is the last one because I have a collab soon and I don't want to get too emotion sick,' prioritizing her well-being for an upcoming event.

## ⏱️ Timeline Breakdown
- **[⏱️ 00:00:06](#t=00:00:06)**: Vestia Zeta sets up a hide-and-seek style game for a pre-trip stream, configuring custom server settings, discussing player count, and expressing initial confusion and accidental movements while attempting to hide.
- **[⏱️ 00:15:03](#t=00:15:03)**: Vestia Zeta engages in a prop hunt game, criticizing a teammate's play, struggling with game mechanics like drawing tools, getting comically stuck in a crawling position, and playfully threatening to 'mass shoot everything' out of frustration.
- **[⏱️ 00:30:00](#t=00:30:00)**: Vestia Zeta continues playing as a prop, struggling with controls and her hiding spots, reacting intensely to close calls, and appreciating the game's detailed environments while trying to evade detection.
- **[⏱️ 00:45:11](#t=00:45:11)**: Vestia Zeta sets up an 'Infection mode' game, meticulously adjusting server configurations, but then spends the majority of the gameplay in escalating frustration, unable to locate other players, and eventually restarting the game on a new map.
- **[⏱️ 01:00:41](#t=01:00:41)**: Vestia Zeta engages in a prop hunt game, expressing frustration with her hunting skills, lamenting missed opportunities, reacting emotionally to discoveries, and playfully deflecting chat comments about her hiding abilities.
- **[⏱️ 01:16:01](#t=01:16:01)**: Vestia Zeta plays hide-and-seek, expressing paranoia about movement, contemplating unique hiding spots like a toilet, humorously forgetting to camouflage her head, and triumphantly taunting hunters after being spotted but remaining untouchable.
- **[⏱️ 01:30:03](#t=01:30:03)**: Vestia Zeta participates in a drawing and guessing game, admiring other players' art while humorously critiquing her own 'shaking' drawing skills, and announcing the final round due to an upcoming collaboration and desire to avoid 'emotion sick' feelings.
- **[⏱️ 01:45:10](#t=01:45:10)**: Vestia Zeta concludes a drawing/guessing game, reviews submitted artwork, expresses enjoyment for the stream, and announces a 30-minute break to mitigate motion sickness before an upcoming 'club' event, planning to play the game again in the future.
